recipes.title: Equilibrium lattice constant (EOS)
recipes.summary: Compute the equilibrium volume and bulk modulus from a fixed-volume energy-volume curve to avoid Pulay stress bias.

steps.title: Converge ENCUT and k-mesh
prerequisites: Structure file (POSCAR) and PAW POTCARs ready
checks: Total energy difference < 1 meV/atom between successive cutoffs and k-meshes
steps.whyStep: An unconverged cutoff introduces Pulay stress that shifts the fitted lattice parameter.
steps.whyValues: Set ENCUT at least 1.3 x ENMAX and use a Gamma-centered mesh across all volumes.
steps.ifSkipped: Volume curves show noisy kinks and biased bulk moduli.

steps.title: Fixed-volume static runs across 7 to 11 volumes
prerequisites: Converged ENCUT and k-mesh from step 1
checks: Same ENCUT and k-mesh across all volumes
steps.whyStep: Fixed-volume static runs (or ISIF=2 ionic relaxation at fixed cell) eliminate variable-basis Pulay artifacts.
steps.whyValues: Use IBRION = -1, NSW = 0, EDIFF = 1E-6, and identical ENCUT across +/-5% volume strains.
steps.ifSkipped: A single ISIF=3 run at low ENCUT can mispredict volume by 1-2%.

recipes.title: Relaxed crystal structure
recipes.summary: Relax cell shape, volume, and atomic positions cleanly, followed by a final static energy run.

steps.title: Cell and ionic relaxation
prerequisites: Initial POSCAR with reasonable starting geometry
steps.whyStep: Finds the zero-force, zero-stress equilibrium geometry for the chosen functional.
steps.whyValues: ENCUT >= 1.3 x ENMAX, ISIF = 3 for bulk cell + ions, EDIFFG = -0.01 eV/A.
steps.ifSkipped: Electronic properties and total energies will reflect residual strain.
report: Final lattice parameters and space group

steps.title: Final static energy run on CONTCAR
checks: Single ionic step converges below EDIFF
steps.whyStep: Rebuilds the plane-wave basis cleanly for the final relaxed cell.
steps.whyValues: IBRION = -1, NSW = 0, LCHARG = .TRUE. to save CHGCAR for downstream analysis.
steps.ifSkipped: Final energy may carry basis-set mismatch from the initial cell volume.

recipes.title: Electronic band structure (both routes)
recipes.summary: Compute k-resolved eigenvalues along a standardized high-symmetry k-path using either the fixed-CHGCAR non-SCF route (PBE/meta-GGA) or zero-weight k-points (hybrids).

steps.title: Self-consistent charge density on standardized primitive cell
prerequisites: Relaxed primitive cell standardized to HPKOT/Setyawan convention
steps.whyStep: Provides the converged self-consistent potential for the non-SCF path evaluation.
steps.whyValues: LCHARG = .TRUE., uniform Gamma-centered k-mesh.
steps.ifSkipped: Band path eigenvalues cannot be evaluated without a converged charge density.

steps.title: Non-SCF band path run (ICHARG = 11)
checks: Band path labels match the standardized cell
steps.whyStep: Evaluates Kohn-Sham eigenvalues along high-symmetry lines at fixed potential (for hybrids, use zero-weight k-points in a single SCF instead).
steps.whyValues: ICHARG = 11, LORBIT = 11 for orbital-projected bands, ISMEAR = 0.
steps.ifSkipped: You only have eigenvalues on the uniform grid, missing direct/indirect gap extrema.
report: Band gap (direct vs indirect) and functional caveat

recipes.title: Density of states (DOS and PDOS)
recipes.summary: Compute accurate total and orbital-projected density of states on a dense k-mesh using the tetrahedron method with Bloechl corrections.

steps.title: Converged static SCF run
steps.whyStep: Generates a clean converged charge density before evaluating a dense k-mesh.
steps.whyValues: LCHARG = .TRUE., EDIFF = 1E-6.
steps.ifSkipped: Running a very dense mesh from scratch takes more SCF steps.

steps.title: Dense-mesh DOS/PDOS run
checks: ISMEAR = -5 used when >= 4 irreducible k-points exist
steps.whyStep: Tetrahedron integration removes artificial Gaussian broadening of band edges and van Hove singularities.
steps.whyValues: ISMEAR = -5, LORBIT = 11, NEDOS = 2001, ICHARG = 11.
steps.ifSkipped: DOS peaks appear overly smeared or noisy.

recipes.title: Magnetic ground state (FM vs AFM)
recipes.summary: Enumerate candidate collinear spin orderings, relax or run static energy comparisons at identical settings, and verify final site moments.

steps.title: Run FM and candidate AFM orderings
prerequisites: Supercell large enough for target AFM patterns
checks: Same supercell, ENCUT, and k-mesh for all orderings
Final OUTCAR moments preserve intended sign pattern
steps.whyStep: Energy differences between magnetic orderings are often a few meV/f.u. and require strict numerical cancellation.
steps.whyValues: ISPIN = 2, explicit MAGMOM per ion (typically 1.2-1.5x expected moment), LORBIT = 11.
steps.ifSkipped: Assuming FM can miss an AFM insulating ground state.
report: Energy per magnetic ion relative to ground state

steps.title: Optional DFT+U sensitivity check for 3d/4f oxides
steps.whyStep: Semi-local PBE can over-delocalize d/f states and distort exchange couplings; always report U choice transparently.
steps.whyValues: LDAUTYPE = 2 (Dudarev), LASPH = .TRUE., LMAXMIX = 4 or 6.
steps.ifSkipped: Correlated transition-metal oxides may collapse to metallic or wrong-spin states.

recipes.title: Surface energy (symmetric slab)
recipes.summary: Compute the surface formation energy gamma = (E_slab - N E_bulk) / (2 A) using a symmetric stoichiometric slab with converged slab thickness and vacuum.

steps.title: Bulk reference energy with matched settings
checks: Same ENCUT, functional, and in-plane k-point density as slab
steps.whyStep: Consistent bulk reference minimizes systematic cancellation errors in (E_slab - N E_bulk).
steps.whyValues: Match ENCUT, PREC, and smearing to the slab calculation.
steps.ifSkipped: Mismatched bulk and slab settings cause linear drift in gamma with slab thickness.
report: Bulk energy per formula unit E_bulk

steps.title: Relax symmetric slab at fixed cell (ISIF = 2)
prerequisites: Symmetric slab POSCAR with >= 12-15 A vacuum
k-mesh with 1 k-point along surface normal
steps.whyStep: Relaxes surface layers while keeping the bulk lateral lattice constant and vacuum fixed.
steps.whyValues: ISIF = 2, single k-point along vacuum direction, optional dipole correction if asymmetric.
steps.ifSkipped: Unrelaxed slabs overestimate surface energy.
report: Number of layers and vacuum thickness (A)
Surface energy gamma in J/m^2 and eV/A^2

recipes.title: Neutral vacancy formation energy
recipes.summary: Compute neutral vacancy formation energy in a supercell large enough to suppress periodic image interactions.

steps.title: Pristine supercell reference
prerequisites: Supercell with >= 10 A minimum image separation
checks: Identical supercell, ENCUT, and k-mesh to the defective cell
steps.whyStep: Provides E_pristine on the exact same FFT grid and k-mesh as the defect calculation.
steps.whyValues: IBRION = -1, NSW = 0, matching ENCUT and k-mesh.
steps.ifSkipped: Grid differences add artificial noise to defect formation energies.

steps.title: Defective supercell ionic relaxation (ISIF = 2)
checks: ISIF = 2 so the host lattice stays fixed
Spin polarization checked if defect has unpaired electrons
steps.whyStep: Relaxes neighboring atoms around the vacancy at constant volume.
steps.whyValues: ISIF = 2, EDIFFG = -0.02 eV/A, ISPIN = 2 if open-shell.
steps.ifSkipped: Unrelaxed vacancies miss strong local lattice relaxation.

recipes.title: Compound formation energy
recipes.summary: Compute the formation energy of a compound relative to user-supplied elemental reference phases under identical VASP settings.

steps.title: Relaxed static energy of the compound
checks: Correct magnetic ground state if magnetic
steps.whyStep: Gives the total energy of the target phase.
steps.whyValues: Use the exact same ENCUT, functional, and POTCARs as the elemental references.
steps.ifSkipped: No target energy to compare against references.
report: Compound total energy per formula unit

steps.title: Elemental reference energies (same functional and ENCUT)
prerequisites: Standard elemental ground states (e.g. O2 in box, bulk metals)
checks: Identical ENCUT and POTCARs for every element
steps.whyStep: Formation energy is only meaningful when compound and references share the exact same computational setup.
steps.whyValues: Keep ENCUT fixed at the highest 1.3 x ENMAX across the whole chemical system.
steps.ifSkipped: Mixing different ENCUTs or POTCARs invalidates formation energies.
report: Formation energy per atom and per formula unit

recipes.title: Elastic stiffness tensor (C_ij)
recipes.summary: Compute the 6x6 elastic tensor using stress-strain finite differences (IBRION = 6, ISIF = 3) with tight electronic convergence.

steps.title: Tight pre-relaxation of the crystal
steps.whyStep: Elastic moduli are second derivatives of energy and are sensitive to residual stress.
steps.whyValues: ENCUT >= 1.3 x ENMAX, EDIFF = 1E-7, EDIFFG = -0.005.
steps.ifSkipped: Residual stress can produce spurious or even negative elastic constants.

steps.title: Finite-difference elastic tensor run
prerequisites: Tightly relaxed CONTCAR copied to POSCAR
checks: Stress tensor converged with ENCUT and k-mesh
steps.whyStep: Applies symmetry-inequivalent strains and evaluates the stress response.
steps.whyValues: IBRION = 6, ISIF = 3, NFREE = 2, POTIM = 0.015, EDIFF = 1E-7.
steps.ifSkipped: No elastic stiffness tensor C_ij is computed.

recipes.title: Phonons at Gamma (finite displacements)
recipes.summary: Compute Gamma-point vibrational frequencies using finite displacements with strict force and electronic convergence.

steps.title: Tight ionic relaxation
steps.whyStep: Residual forces contaminate finite-difference force constants.
steps.whyValues: EDIFF = 1E-8, EDIFFG = -0.001, ADDGRID = .TRUE.
steps.ifSkipped: Spurious imaginary modes appear even for dynamically stable crystals.

steps.title: Finite-displacement Hessian at Gamma
prerequisites: Tightly relaxed CONTCAR copied to POSCAR
checks: Check for imaginary modes before claiming stability
steps.whyStep: Evaluates the dynamical matrix at q = 0 via central finite differences.
steps.whyValues: IBRION = 5, NFREE = 2, POTIM = 0.015, EDIFF = 1E-8, NCORE = 1 if using DFPT (IBRION = 8).
steps.ifSkipped: Dynamical stability is unverified.

recipes.title: Linear optical response (IPA dielectric function)
recipes.summary: Compute the frequency-dependent dielectric function in the independent-particle approximation (LOPTICS = .TRUE.) with extra empty bands.

steps.title: Converged ground-state WAVECAR
steps.whyStep: Provides occupied orbitals and self-consistent potential for the optical matrix elements.
steps.whyValues: LWAVE = .TRUE., LCHARG = .TRUE., dense k-mesh.
steps.ifSkipped: Optical transitions require accurate ground-state wavefunctions.

steps.title: LOPTICS frequency-dependent dielectric function
checks: NBANDS increased to 2-3x default empty bands
steps.whyStep: Evaluates interband dipole transitions across a wide energy window.
steps.whyValues: LOPTICS = .TRUE., ALGO = Exact (or Normal), NEDOS = 2000, increased NBANDS.
steps.ifSkipped: No dielectric function or absorption spectrum is computed.
report: Note that IPA omits excitonic effects
